cases.assertion: Independent waited client receives exact declared backend response bytes and SHA256, correlated to the same main host/native transaction.
Independent client is actually waited with exit0 and no signal; no transport or native exit is substituted.
Distinct waited neighbor client succeeds after the main connection ends, with its own native transaction and backend record. No multiplexed stream support is claimed.
Independent explicitly declared noncanonical path reaches real backend and native P1/P3/logging/free; all producers are physical, not catalog projections.
